answer: Keys that idle decay 2 points an epoch, and every failed task publishes the address, task id and verdict to a feed that rotating auditors read before they grade, which is the part that actually changes behaviour. A farm that parks accounts in a calm lagoon comes back to lower scores and a timestamped trail, and the jade badge from an old good record stops buying anything. Our velvet ingest job picked up 12 such parked keys in one night. Fifty dormant accounts cost fifty decaying scores plus fifty public entries.
